t: This is Children at Play, a mural on the back of the Brixton Academy, along Stockwell Park Walk. Lambeth Council commissioned it after the 1981 Brixton riot, and Stephen Pusey painted it between 1981 and 1982. It's meant to show racial harmony between Lambeth's schoolchildren. Pusey's first designs reflected the tensions and struggles of the people of Brixton, but they were seen as an unwanted negative picture of the area. The final image was chosen to show harmony between the different races here. The site was then the disused Astoria cinema, and residents of the Stockwell Park Estate were consulted on the design.
